FACT: Ned explicitly refused to consider Jarvis-style systems (separate bot with Telegram, cron jobs, etc.) because it would require using the Claude API token outside Claude Code, which violates Anthropic's terms of service.

CONTEXT: When shown the Jarvis project (same author as memory-ts), Ned said 'I would much prefer to redo memory than have a different bot like it's against anthropic rules to use the API token somewhere else and my primary point is to use the true Claude Code.'

AFFECTS: Any memory/AI tooling must be Claude Code hooks only. No standalone agents, no API-key-based services running separately. Workarounds: local LLMs (LM Studio) are fine for preprocessing/categorization since they don't use the Anthropic token.
